name: Astartes Shield
summary: Gives the bearer a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Auspex Array
summary: Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer gain the Ignores Cover ability.

name: Blackstar Cluster Launcher
summary: When this model ends a Normal move, target one enemy unit it moved over and roll six D6: each 5+ deals 1 mortal wound to that unit.

name: Death to the Alien
summary: When a model in this unit attacks, re-roll a Hit roll of 1, or re-roll any Hit roll if the target lacks the Imperium or Chaos keywords.

name: Fortis Doctrines
summary: Each time a model in this unit attacks a unit below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll; if the target is also Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll instead.

name: Indomitor Doctrines
summary: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack against the closest eligible target, or a melee attack in a turn it made a Charge move, improve that attack's Strength by 2.

name: Infernum Halo-launcher
summary: The bearer has the Smoke keyword.

name: Instigator Bolt Carbine
summary: After the bearer's unit shoots, it can make a Normal move, but becomes ineligible to declare a charge for the rest of the turn if it does.

name: Spectrus Doctrines
summary: At the end of the opponent's turn, if this unit is more than 6" from all enemy units, you may remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

name: Strategic Knowledge
summary: While this model leads a unit, that unit remains eligible to shoot and to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Tactical Instinct
summary: While this model leads a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the Lethal Hits ability.

name: Talonstrike Doctrines
summary: When this unit is set up on the battlefield, until the end of the turn its weapons gain +1 Armour Penetration and its melee weapons gain the Lance ability.

name: Unstoppable Champion
summary: The first time this model is destroyed, roll a D6 at the end of the phase; on 2+, return it to the battlefield near where it fell, out of Engagement Range, with 1 wound remaining.

name: Watch Master
summary: Once per battle round, when a unit with this ability is targeted by a Stratagem, its CP cost is reduced by 1.
